notes.title: Update v1.2
notes.content:
Hello!
Soldier Killer have a some news:
- Medicament - Add some health points. Select third slot and press E.
- Enemys doesn't destroy. Now they are falling backward and they lying all the time.
- New winter map.
- New Soldier! Blue Soldiers have a higher rank than Reds. They are faster, stronger and have better eyesight.

notes.title: Update v1.1
notes.content:
Hello!
Soldier Killer have a some news:
- The camera is at a lower angle, so more elements on map can be seen.
- Added a two slots in inventory (the lower left corner of the screen).
- In a first slot in inventory is the gun - ak47, and in the second slot is the grenade. Press "E" to fire.
- A little changed graphic design (inter alia darkening at the edges of the screen).
- Soldiers can now see the player from a greater distance.
- Soldiers and player have now texture on head ;)
- Soldiers can drop a grenade.
- New animation: walk left and right, throw grenade.
- Fix some bugs.

We plan make in next update a new weapon - sword, new maps, and new type of soldier - better and stronger. These things will surely appear in the Soldier Killer. 
If you have any ideas for news - comment ;)
